title: Team Protocols
description: Request-response protocols with durable request records

steps.content: Work is done. Shut down the team gracefully.
steps.annotation: Can't just kill threads -- need coordinated shutdown via protocol
request_id correlates the request with the response

steps.content:
[RequestRecord] req_abc123 created
  State: pending
  Envelope: { type: "shutdown_request", from: "lead", to: "backend-dev", request_id: "req_abc123" }
  Written to: .team/requests/req_abc123.json
steps.annotation: Durable request record persisted to disk -- survives context compression

steps.content:
[backend-dev] Received shutdown request req_abc123
  Current task: none (idle)
  Decision: approve
  -> lead inbox: { type: "shutdown_response", request_id: "req_abc123", approved: true }
steps.annotation: Teammate decides based on its own state; response references same request_id

steps.content:
[RequestRecord] req_abc123 updated
  State: pending -> approved
  Response: { approved: true }
  backend-dev thread stopped
  Status: idle -> shutdown
steps.annotation: State transition is the teaching spine: pending -> approved is what matters

steps.content: backend-dev shut down gracefully. The protocol used a durable request record with request_id correlation. The same pattern handles plan approval and handoff.
steps.annotation: One pattern (request_id + state machine), multiple coordination applications
